limits: Emits the set with its junction warnings; it designs and checks nothing.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Writes an index set in the form the next step reads; the set's properties come from audit_barcodes.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does this index set look like as an order sheet, a FASTA, a SampleSheet, or the actual oligos?

description: Write an index set out in the form the next step needs: a CSV or TSV order sheet, FASTA, an IDT bulk-input sheet of the bare tags, an Illumina BCLConvert SampleSheet, or the actual oligos — adapters built on a template, or primers carrying the tag — with the junction warnings that emission produces.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

adapter_3.description: sequence 3' of the tag in the adapter — the TruSeq read-1 primer, as the panel offers. Only applies when format is adapters.

adapter_5.description: sequence 5' of the tag in the adapter — the Illumina P5, as the panel offers. Only applies when format is adapters.

barcodes.description: the index sequences to write out.

format.description: what to write. Values: csv (CSV order sheet), tsv (TSV), fasta (FASTA), idt (IDT bulk input), samplesheet (Illumina SampleSheet), adapters (Adapter oligos), primers (Tagged primers).

idt_purification.description: IDT purification (e.g. STD, PAGE, HPLC). Check what your scale allows before ordering. Only applies when format is idt.

idt_scale.description: IDT synthesis scale, exactly as IDT writes it (e.g. 25nm, 100nm, 250nm). Asked for rather than defaulted: which options exist depends on oligo length. Only applies when format is idt.

prefix.description: name prefix for the rows (BC001, BC002 …).

primer.description: the primer the tag is added to. Only applies when format is primers.

name: export_barcodes

oligos.description: the emitted oligos, for the adapter and primer formats — empty for the text formats

text.description: the written file, for the text formats

warnings.description: junction warnings the emission found — a tag that creates a homopolymer or a restriction site at its junction. Empty for the text formats, which build no junction
